summary: XPEL filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of real property (San Antonio facility) for $60.4 million via wholly-owned subsidiary Harvest, financing $44.8 million with a 10-year building loan from PNC Bank at Term SOFR + 1.25% (4.7% at close). The company also amended its existing Wells Fargo credit facility to permit this debt. No securities transaction, shareholder vote, or strategic catalyst is involved. This is a routine property acquisition and financing arrangement, not a special situation.
